readingOrder.title: Recommended Reading Order
steps: Start with the proxy type guide to decide whether stability, coverage, or throughput matters most.
Move to pricing and use case pages so product fit and budget fit are evaluated with the same logic.
After the decision is clear, use the help center and rollout playbooks to reduce onboarding gaps.

faqs.q: Which section should teams start with?
faqs.a: Start with the proxy type guide and pricing evaluation if the team is still deciding. Move to use cases and product pages when the workload is already clear. Use the help center when the team is in onboarding.

faqs.q: What is the difference between the resource hub and the help center?
faqs.a: The resource hub is the decision and discovery layer for definitions, selection, and methods. The help center is the detailed documentation layer for API, authentication, onboarding, and operations.

faqs.q: Which pages are best for internal review or procurement decisions?
faqs.a: The most useful pages are the proxy type selection guide, pricing page, use case overview, and the enterprise onboarding playbook because they combine product fit, rollout logic, and evaluation criteria.
